vi.heroAlt: Stealth Browser Console — quản lý hồ sơ CloakBrowser & tự động hóa cục bộ

en.heroAlt: Stealth Browser Console — CloakBrowser antidetect profiles & local automation
en.footNote: Stealth Browser Console runs locally on your PC with an isolated CloakBrowser engine, separating browser fingerprints, cookies, proxies, and workflow scripts.
en.downloadNote: Windows 64-bit installer, bundled Cookie Bridge (E0001), Browser Operator (E0002) & auto-update included
